name: EC-17 hold-out blaster
description: The EC-17 hold-out blaster, also known as the EC-17 blaster, scout pistol, flash pistol, or scout trooper blaster, was a standard-issue hold-out blaster pistol for Imperial scout troopers and patrol troopers, manufactured by BlasTech Industries.
